name: qlrisk_backtest
title: VaR / ES backtest and PLA test
description: Validate a risk model. mode='portfolio' backtests the book's historical VaR and ES over test_days of (synthetic or supplied) history and runs the FRTB P&L attribution test: exceptions, Kupiec POF, Christoffersen independence, Basel traffic-light zone and multiplier, Acerbi-Szekely ES Z-tests, PLA Spearman / KS zone. mode='var_series' / 'es_series' / 'pla' test series you supply (P&L, VaR/ES forecasts as positive losses, HPL and RTPL). Example: {"mode": "var_series", "pnl": [...250 numbers], "var_forecasts": [...250 numbers]}.
